summary.en: A 32-second synthetic text card sequence displaying travel titles over black backgrounds, preceded by six seconds of black frames.
summary.zh: 一段32秒的黑底文字合成视频，前6秒为黑屏，随后展示两段清晨散步提示文字。

strongest_moment.en: The transition to the route instruction at 00:16 setting a clear walking starting point.
strongest_moment.zh: 00:16处切入具体路线说明，清晰指示了步行起点。

audience.en: Viewers seeking peaceful morning walking route suggestions.
audience.zh: 寻找清晨平静散步路线建议的观众。

reason.en: The first 6 seconds are completely blank, failing to engage viewers.
reason.zh: 前6秒完全黑屏无内容，缺乏有效开场。

reason.en: Text statements are clear, minimal, and easily readable.
reason.zh: 文字表意清晰明了，极简且易于阅读。

reason.en: Extended holds on static text and the dead opening drag pacing.
reason.zh: 开篇黑屏冗长且静态文字停留时间过长，节奏偏慢。

reason.en: Static typography on black with no real-world scenic footage.
reason.zh: 全片仅为黑底静态文字排版，缺乏真实风景画面。

reason.en: Silent with no voiceover, ambient sound, or music.
reason.zh: 全片无声，缺少旁白、环境音或背景音乐。

observation.en: Six seconds of silent black video frames.
observation.zh: 持续6秒的静音黑屏画面。

observation.en: Text displays 'A QUIET MORNING / Walk through the park'.
observation.zh: 屏幕显示文字：'A QUIET MORNING / Walk through the park'。

observation.en: Text displays 'THE WALKING ROUTE / Start at the main gate'.
observation.zh: 屏幕显示文字：'THE WALKING ROUTE / Start at the main gate'。

evidence.en: The video starts with 6.0 seconds of uninformative black frames.
evidence.zh: 视频前6.0秒为无信息的黑屏等待。

improvement.en: Remove the first 6 seconds so the first informative text card displays instantly.
improvement.zh: 删去前6秒黑屏，使首张主题文字卡立即呈现。

uncertainties.en: Intended final audio track or ambient soundscape was not provided.
uncertainties.zh: 未提供预期的音频音轨或环境背景声。

method.en: Immediate visual engagement without empty frames at the start.
method.zh: 开头立即进入主题展示，不留空白帧。

fit.en: Removing the 6-second black space brings immediate focus to the title card.
fit.zh: 删去6秒黑屏可让观众即刻看到散步主题卡片。

observations.en: The initial 6-second black frame was cleanly trimmed, starting immediately on 'A QUIET MORNING'.
observations.zh: 开篇6秒黑屏已精准去除，成片直接展示“A QUIET MORNING”。

observations.en: Text cards and factual content are fully preserved across the 26-second render without glitches.
observations.zh: 两段文字卡与事实信息完整保留，全片26秒无任何视觉瑕疵。
